qualifications: These are limited heldout samples using explicitly unpinned Gateway aliases, not full-dataset or official leaderboard scores.
LongMemEval uses source-attributed native judge prompt wording. LoCoMo uses a separate semantic-reference diagnostic with exact abstention handling.
Repeated identical judge prompts share one decision; the LLM judge remains fallible across distinct answers or runs.
The zero LongMemEval paired interval describes identical outcomes on this sample, not proven population equivalence.
The LoCoMo difference does not establish superiority over BM25; its paired interval includes zero.
The LongMemEval sample contains five unanswerable questions, and the LoCoMo sample contains nine. Their category balance limits generalization.
Usage accounting uses listed inference rates and available cache discounts; it is not a consolidated provider invoice. Unknown earlier requests retain conservative reservations.
Reader input-token savings are not total-system cost savings. Learned extraction and real-agent memory-writing behavior remain unmeasured.
The anchor-first experiment was not promoted after its development results were worse than the existing window adapters.
